headline: Lincoln go through the conference season unbeaten
dek: Lincoln closed their conference schedule by beating McKendree. They have twelve wins and four draws this season, and the defeat column is still empty.
displaced_by: results night: Lincoln's win over McKendree completed an unbeaten conference schedule; Lake Erie's win over Tiffin was the other result that settled a title, and the G-MAC card already prints that no one can catch them
